model.name: Shipping Mogul RFA Tender Selection
model.question: How are complex Request For Approval (RFA) tenders evaluated and selected for large-scale maritime shipping contracts?
model.summary: This model represents how a global shipping enterprise screens provider bids, applies operational safety ceilings, evaluates routing variables, and contracts vessel capacity through secure channels.

layers.name: Commercial and Rules
layers.role: Contains channels, rules, and terms. No technical infrastructure details belong here.

layers.name: Fleet Operations
layers.role: Contains providers, variables, and ceilings. No contracting rules belong here.

layers.name: Data and Integrations
layers.role: Contains datastores, integrations, and apps. No business actors belong here.

nodes.label: Global B2B Tender Portal
nodes.note: Primary digital channel where shipping providers submit RFA bids.

nodes.label: Vessel Age and Safety Rule
nodes.note: Mandatory condition filtering out providers with high-risk historical incident profiles.

nodes.label: Demurrage Charge Definition
nodes.note: Defined financial penalty framework for cargo loading delays.

nodes.label: Third-Party Fleet Provider
nodes.note: External shipping contractor participating in the RFA tender.

nodes.label: Current Bunkering Fuel Index
nodes.note: Measured market fact used to calculate total route economics.

nodes.label: Port Channel Depth Ceiling
nodes.note: Hard physical limit on vessel draught for specific docking facilities.

nodes.label: Tender Contract Ledger
nodes.note: Secure repository holding final awarded shipping contracts and terms.

logic.goal: Filter and select compliant shipping tender applications against physical ceilings and cost variables.

steps.name: Ingest Tender Bids
steps.intent: Pull electronic bids from the tender portal

steps.name: Evaluate Rules and Ceilings
steps.intent: Check provider metrics against safety ceilings and fuel variables

steps.name: Executive Award Decision
steps.intent: Maritime director signs off on winning tender contracts
